description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
When Kiki-Jiki enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both Blasting Station triggers from this step and step 4, untapping it.
Repeat.
